cis_text.title: Manage Default Accounts on Enterprise Assets and Software

ai_guidance.agent: Disable or secure default accounts provided with agent platforms, vector databases, and orchestration tools. Default credentials on agent infrastructure (e.g., a vector database admin console) are a primary vector for attackers to gain control over the agent’s memory and logic.

cis_text.control_title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software

evidence.rationale: Default accounts are defined as built-in or factory/provider-set accounts across systems, software, and devices. Managing, changing default passwords, disabling state accounts, or otherwise hardening them through additional mechanisms directly constrains an adversary's abuse of the valid account technique.
